result.summary: A spawned native child now runs under the parent loop's hook control (pre-step waterfall incl. vetoes, and turnStopping) instead of NO_HOOKS, and records a signed `audit` row (`kind: "delegation/hook-control"`, version 1) in its own session before its first turn naming the inherited controls, the approval gate, the signed stop conditions/scope it was declared under, and the narrower descendant limits it passes on; a child built with no control records `source: "none", inherited: []`. The kernel passes the same `hooks` object it composes for the root into `createDriverRunner`, so grandchildren inherit the same control. New tests (6) went RED before implementation, GREEN after; five mutations each went RED; 26 related test files / 279 tests green; both typechecks clean. Measured at 2eed9bee49587e1e7a2197d3b2c1c973b0e61728 on Darwin 25.6.0 arm64, Node v25.5.0, pnpm 10.33.0, scripted LLM adapter only.

tests/subagentHookInheritance.test.ts: the parent's turn-stopping hook runs on the child's turn, under the child's turn number
tests/subagentHookInheritance.test.ts: the inheritance is recorded in the child's signed session before its first turn, naming every control that governed it
tests/subagentHookInheritance.test.ts: a child built with no hook control records the absence instead of claiming a control it does not have
tests/subagentHookInheritance.test.ts: a continued child records its controls once, at spawn, not once per turn

result.typecheck: pnpm typecheck (tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit): exit 0. pnpm typecheck:tests (tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit): exit 0. Both run at 2eed9bee + these edits, Node v25.5.0. (A first pass failed with TS7006 on the Object.freeze'd hook literal and TS2493 on a zero-arg vi.fn in the test; both fixed, re-run clean.)
behaviorChanges: createDriverRunner accepts an optional `hookControl: LoopHookControl` (Pick<LoopHooks,'preStep'|'turnStopping'>); every child it builds runs under those hooks instead of NO_HOOKS. `notify` is deliberately NOT inherited (LoopNotification carries no session identity; forwarding would present child steps as the parent's).

Every native child session now carries one signed `audit` row before its first turn with meta {kind:'delegation/hook-control', version:1, source:'parent-loop'|'none', inherited:[...], approvalGate:{actionClass,riskTier,toolNames|null}|null, stopConditions, descendantStopConditions, delegationScope, descendantDelegationScope, governedAs, runAs, depth}. Continued children record it once at spawn, not per turn.

runComposedTurn (kernel) passes the same `hooks` object it composes for the root loop into the native createDriverRunner, so a parent pre-step veto now yields a `loop/veto` row in the child's session (by: <vetoing party>) and no request/header, and grandchildren inherit the same control through the recursive runner.

Row count per child session increases by one (the audit row); readAgentRunSummary's unsignedRows stays 0 (the row is written through recordProjectedEvidence, inside the spine, signed) — the runner's own unsigned-row refusal did not trigger in any test.
src/agent/delegateTool.ts was in scope but needed no change: control flows through the runner, not the tool.
decisions: WORKTREE DISCREPANCY: the assigned worktree was at 3d6b8d4a (an old main commit; none of the scoped files or plans/ existed), not at 2eed9bee as stated. 3d6b8d4a is an ancestor of 2eed9bee, so I ran `git merge --ff-only 2eed9bee…` on my OWN worktree branch (worktree-wf_453236ab-c47-1). No commit was created, no other branch/worktree/stash/.git internals touched; HEAD verified as 2eed9bee49587e1e7a2197d3b2c1c973b0e61728 before and after the work.

Recording the absence rather than refusing a hook-less child: refusing would break every direct createDriverRunner caller (foreign contract, cancellation, continuation tests) and the brief allowed either; the row's `source:'none'` makes the absence auditable, and M4 proves the record cannot lie about it.

Record via recordProjectedEvidence({eventType:'audit'}) with a `kind` discriminator, matching the existing nativeValidation / delegationEvidenceWriter convention — the only sanctioned way evidence enters the spine without widening SessionService (out of my write scope). No new LoopEventRecord kind was added (loopEventMeta.ts is out of scope).

Hooks and the recorded `inherited` list derive from one snapshot (childHooks) so the row and the driver cannot disagree; M1/M5 show the tests still catch a driver that drops or bypasses the hooks even when the record claims them.

Did not add an in-loop max-turns/timeout guard on the child: spawnSubagent already enforces the signed stop conditions and descendantStopConditions narrows them (AMC-1545); adding a second guard would be decoration (brief §2 rule 7). The row records both the declared and the descendant limits instead.
Did not run `pnpm build` — all exercised tests import from src/, none needed dist/.
blockers: Foreign runners (options.delegation.runner supplied, or src/ledger/monitor.ts spawnGovernedChild) do not pass through createDriverRunner, so a child executed by them gets neither the inherited control nor a hook-control row — the absence is NOT recorded on that path. Out of IMPL-3's write scope; next step: have spawnSubagent (src/agent/subagentSpawn.ts) write the absence into the parent's delegation-started row or require runners to declare their control.

The inherited preStep is the parent's composed waterfall, which includes contextPreStep bound to the PARENT's sessionId; when it runs under a child, context plugins refresh with the parent's session id. The injected context lands in the child's own inbox/session rows, but plugin-side attribution was not exercised by any test here. Next step: thread the child session id into a per-child prompt seam if plugin attribution matters.

Not exercised: the full vitest suite, `pnpm build`/dist, Playwright e2e, the CLI delegation flag end-to-end with a real provider (all runs used the scripted adapter + silent transport), and package/platform qualification. This is source qualification of one track only.
result.reportMarkdown:
## IMPL-3 — subagent hook-control inheritance

**Commit:** 2eed9bee49587e1e7a2197d3b2c1c973b0e61728 (amc/gap-register-execution) + uncommitted edits in worktree `/Users/sid/AgentMaturityCompass/.claude/worktrees/wf_453236ab-c47-1`
**Environment:** Darwin 25.6.0 arm64, Node v25.5.0, pnpm 10.33.0, vitest 4.1.11; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline` exit 0.
**Worktree note:** the worktree was handed over at 3d6b8d4a (scoped files absent). Fast-forwarded my own worktree branch to 2eed9bee with `git merge --ff-only` (ancestor confirmed). No commit, no other tree touched.

### What changed
- `src/agent/loopTypes.ts` (+13): `export type LoopHookControl = Pick<LoopHooks, "preStep" | "turnStopping">` with a note on why `notify` is excluded.
- `src/agent/subagentRunner.ts` (+87/−1): `DriverRunnerInit.hookControl?`; `childHooks(control)` builds the child's `LoopHooks` and the `inherited` list from one snapshot; `recordHookControl(...)` writes one signed `audit` row (`kind: "delegation/hook-control"`, `version: 1`) into the child's session before the driver exists; `new AgentDriver({... hooks ...})`.
- `src/kernel/agentLoopRunner.ts` (+5): `hookControl: hooks` on the native `createDriverRunner` call — the same object the root loop runs under.
- `tests/subagentHookInheritance.test.ts` (new, 6 tests).
- `src/agent/delegateTool.ts`: in scope, unchanged (control flows via the runner).

### Row shape (child session, before `turn/start`)
`{kind, version:1, source:"parent-loop"|"none", inherited:["preStep","turnStopping"]|[], approvalGate:{actionClass,riskTier,toolNames|null}|null, stopConditions, descendantStopConditions, delegationScope, descendantDelegationScope, governedAs, runAs, depth}` — the signed declaration the child was spawned under plus the narrower limits it passes on (extends AMC-1545's `descendantStopConditions`).

### Evidence (all produced this session)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| New file before implementation | 6 failed / 0 passed (RED for the right reasons: child called the model, turnStopping not called, no row) |
| New file after implementation | 6 passed |
| Related set: `vitest run subagent delegat Delegat kernelDelegationGrant nativeChildStopOutput nativeDelegationInheritance agentLoop composedTurn` (26 files, enumerated) | 279 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 34.5 s |
| Baseline at 2eed9bee before edits (13-file subset) | 142 passed |
| `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm typecheck:tests` | exit 0 / exit 0 |

**Mutations (each applied, run, restored byte-identical — `diff` against backup empty):**
M1 drop `hooks` from AgentDriver → 2 RED; M2 drop the record → 4 RED; M3 drop `hookControl: hooks` in kernel → 1 RED; M4 record claims inheritance when none → 1 RED; M5 preStep passes through to `next()` → 1 RED.

### Not exercised / open
- Foreign runners (`options.delegation.runner`, `ledger/monitor.ts spawnGovernedChild`) bypass `createDriverRunner`: no inherited control and no absence row on that path (out of scope; next step in `subagentSpawn.ts`).
- The inherited `contextPreStep` refreshes plugins with the parent's sessionId when running under the child; plugin attribution not tested.
- Full suite, `pnpm build`, e2e, real provider transport, package/platform qualification: not run.
